From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>

Subject: AWS CPPO: reseller technical certification + billing gaps (next steps)

Hi Kelly —

Thanks again for the call this morning. Per our discussion I wanted to capture the outstanding items we need to close before CPPO activation:

1) Technical certification matrix (who on BrightLeaf will complete network/VPC verification, private registry access, and container runtime tests).
2) SKU/price mapping for Marketplace SKUs -> BrightLeaf entitlement IDs (we need a CSV we can push into the entitlement pipeline).
3) Billing reconciliation gaps: merchant fee passthrough and invoice routing (we saw mismatched payor fields on a sample invoice).
4) PO and procurement timeline: when can BrightLeaf accept a shipping PO so we can test settlement?

I've attached a starting certification_matrix.xlsx and a very rough SKU template to fill. Can you confirm owners and a target date for the items above? Our ask is to close certification and SKU mapping by COB Tues (2027-05-11) to hit the earliest activation window the week of 5/17.

Attachments: certification_matrix.xlsx (xlsx), sku_map_template.csv (csv)

Thanks —
Marcus Lin
Strategic Partnerships | Redwood Inference
marcus.lin@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0142

Subject: Re: AWS CPPO: reseller technical certification + billing gaps (next steps)

Marcus —

Appreciate the clear list. Quick responses inline:

1) Technical certification: I will own network/VPC + partner runtime verification, Samir (cc'd in my internal thread) will own container runtime tests. We will fill the certification_matrix and return by Friday 5/7 EOD.
2) SKU mapping: we need a slightly enhanced template showing marketplace SKU, offer id, BrightLeaf entitlement id, list price, and reseller net. Can Ben provide the expanded template?
3) Billing gap: we saw the same sample invoice discrepancy. Our finance team needs a short note that explains expected merchant fee flow and the payor mapping you want — otherwise we cannot reconcile.
4) PO: we can sign a test PO by next Wednesday 5/12; legal prefers to review any DocuSign before the 11th.

Attaching our capability brief for context. Also linking the HubSpot deal for your Ops team: https://hubspot.com/deal/BR-4231

Best,

- Ben: expand the SKU template to include offer-id and reseller-net columns, then ingest BrightLeaf's values into sku_map_v1.csv. Target: Mon 5/10 EOD.
- Vanessa: produce a 1-page billing note (merchant fee flow diagram + expected payor fields) that we can send to BrightLeaf finance. Target: Tue 5/11 COB.
- Priyom: track DocuSign/PO path and confirm whether we need an Amazon PO template for test settlement.

Kelly — I'll upload a revised certification_matrix_v2.xlsx to the shared drive and drop the link here once Ben has the SKU mapping populated. If you think 5/11 is tight, call out the earliest date you can commit for certification + SKU deliverables.
